description: Tautulli playback, aggregate users, and retained library history. Counts and durations use actual API measurements. Inventory refreshes every five minutes; titles and viewer identities are excluded.

panels.title: Service Health
panels.description: Scrape, Tautulli API, Plex connection, and relay must all report healthy.

panels.title: Active Sessions
panels.description: Active playback sessions reported by Tautulli.

panels.title: Transcodes
panels.description: Sessions requiring transcoding.

panels.title: Session Bandwidth
panels.description: Total active-session bandwidth converted by upstream from kbps to bytes per second.

panels.title: Active Libraries
panels.description: Libraries currently active in Plex; excludes retained historical libraries.

panels.title: Known Users
panels.description: Users known to Tautulli; viewer identities are not exported.

panels.title: Recorded Plays
panels.description: Recorded library play totals, including retained library history.

panels.title: Recorded Watch Time
panels.description: Recorded watch duration across tracked libraries; not media runtime.

panels.title: Sessions by Playback Decision
panels.description: Tautulli's direct play, direct stream, copy, and transcode session decisions.

panels.title: Player States
panels.description: Playing, paused, and buffering sessions.

panels.title: Bandwidth by Network Scope
panels.description: LAN, WAN, and total bandwidth. Total includes its components; series are not stacked.

panels.title: Sessions by Network Location
panels.description: Sessions on LAN, WAN, and relay.

panels.title: Sessions by Media Type
panels.description: Current movie, episode, track, live, and clip playback counts.

panels.title: Recorded Plays by Library
panels.description: Historical library play totals retained by Tautulli.

panels.title: Recorded Watch Time by Library
panels.description: Historical watch duration, not total playable duration.

panels.title: Top-level Items by Library
panels.description: Movies, shows, or artists depending on the library type. These distinct units are not summed.

panels.title: Seasons / Albums by Library
panels.description: Parent items: seasons in show libraries and albums in music libraries.

panels.title: Episodes / Tracks by Library
panels.description: Child items: episodes in show libraries and tracks in music libraries.

panels.title: Tracked and Active Libraries
panels.description: Tracked records include retained library history; active count is separate.

panels.title: Aggregate User Inventory
panels.description: User inventory flags are overlapping categories, not current viewers.

panels.title: Recorded Library Plays Over Time
panels.description: Stored lifetime totals sampled into Prometheus. No rate is derived from this mutable gauge.

panels.title: Recorded Watch Time Over Time
panels.description: Stored lifetime watch duration, including retained history.

panels.title: Metrics Health History
panels.description: Independent scrape, API, Plex, and relay health.

panels.title: Activity Poll Age
panels.description: Age of the last successful activity poll. Inventory refreshes every five minutes.

panels.title: Activity Poll Duration
panels.description: Duration of the exporter activity poll.

panels.title: Encrypted Sessions
panels.description: Sessions with encrypted connections to Plex.

panels.title: Plex Update Available
panels.description: Exporter-reported update status, refreshed every 30 minutes.
